[FIXTURE] Week one signal

This is the first week of the build. We wrote the spec set, sorted out the repository shape, and agreed on the typed model. The first gate we closed was the spec review, which every later change now has to pass.

The open question for next week is onboarding: how a newcomer gets oriented without reading everything first. Work continues in small, reviewed steps, and nothing is published until a human says yes.
